Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. routine (n)
/ruːˈtiːn/
thói quen, lịch trình hàng ngày
Collocation: daily routine, morning routine
"My morning routine starts at 6:30 AM with thirty minutes of reading."
2. community (n)
/kəˈmjuːnəti/
cộng đồng cư dân
Collocation: local community, community service
"We should actively contribute to our local community."
3. volunteer (v, n)
/ˌvɒlənˈtɪər/
làm tình nguyện, tình nguyện viên
Collocation: volunteer work, volunteer at a shelter
"Many high school students volunteer at local charities on weekends."
4. citizen (n)
/ˈsɪtɪzn/
công dân
Collocation: global citizen, responsible citizen
"Every student can learn to become a responsible global citizen."
5. participate (v)
/pɑːˈtɪsɪpeɪt/
tham gia vào (đi với giới từ 'in')
Collocation: participate in green projects, actively participate
"Students are encouraged to participate in environmental activities."
6. habit (n)
/ˈhæbɪt/
thói quen cá nhân
Collocation: form a good habit, break a bad habit
"Reading English books every night is an excellent study habit."
7. lifestyle (n)
/ˈlaɪfstaɪl/
lối sống, phong cách sống
Collocation: healthy lifestyle, sustainable lifestyle
"Cycling to school instead of driving promotes a green lifestyle."
8. neighborhood (n)
/ˈneɪbəhʊd/
khu dân cư, khu phố
Collocation: in the neighborhood, safe neighborhood
"There is a modern public library in our neighborhood."
9. goal (n)
/ɡəʊl/
mục tiêu phấn đấu
Collocation: set a goal, achieve an IELTS goal
"My primary academic goal this year is to achieve IELTS Band 5.5."
10. support (v, n)
/səˈpɔːt/
hỗ trợ, ủng hộ
Collocation: support the elderly, give emotional support
"Dedicated teachers provide continuous support to their students."
11. environment (n)
/ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt/
môi trường tự nhiên và sống
Collocation: protect the environment, marine environment
"Reducing single-use plastic helps protect the marine environment."
12. improve (v)
/ɪmˈpruːv/
cải thiện, nâng cao
Collocation: improve skills, improve English fluency
"Daily speaking practice helps improve your pronunciation significantly."
13. sustainable (adj)
/səˈsteɪnəbl/
bền vững, thân thiện lâu dài
Collocation: sustainable development, sustainable habits
"Solar energy is a sustainable solution for modern cities."
14. international (adj)
/ˌɪntəˈnæʃnəl/
quốc tế, đa quốc gia
Collocation: international organization, international students
"The United Nations is the largest international organization in the world."
15. opportunity (n)
/ˌɒpəˈtjuːnəti/
cơ hội, dịp thuận lợi
Collocation: valuable opportunity, equal opportunity
"Volunteering abroad offers young people a valuable opportunity to grow."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Căn Bản (Foundation - Band 3.5 - 4.0)

• Thì Hiện tại đơn (Present Simple): Diễn tả thói quen lặp đi lặp lại, sự thật hiển nhiên hoặc lịch trình cố định. Dấu hiệu: always, usually, often, every day, on weekends.
  Công thức: S + V(s/es) | Phủ định: S + do/does not + V-bare
  Ví dụ: Linh participates in community cleanups every Saturday.

• Thì Hiện tại tiếp diễn (Present Continuous): Diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra ngay lúc nói hoặc một xu hướng tạm thời. Dấu hiệu: now, right now, at the moment, currently, this week.
  Công thức: S + am / is / are + V-ing
  Ví dụ: Currently, our neighborhood is planting fifty new trees.

• Bẫy Stative Verbs (Động từ trạng thái): Các từ chỉ nhận thức, cảm xúc, sở hữu (know, understand, believe, want, like, belong to, need) KHÔNG BAO GIỜ chia ở thì tiếp diễn!

🔵 Tầng 2: Nâng Cao (Band 5.0+ Nuances)

• Cấu trúc phàn nàn (Always + Present Continuous): Dùng để phàn nàn về một thói quen xấu lặp đi lặp lại gây khó chịu.
  Ví dụ: He is always leaving plastic bottles on the classroom floor!

• Động từ lưỡng tính (Stative vs Dynamic):
  - think: Tin rằng (I think volunteering is meaningful) vs Đang cân nhắc (I am thinking about joining the club).
  - have: Sở hữu (I have a bicycle) vs Đang trải nghiệm/ăn uống (We are having a community meeting now).

• Câu ghép với liên từ FANBOYS (Compound Sentences): Sử dụng and, but, so, or sau dấu phẩy để nối 2 mệnh đề độc lập giúp tăng điểm Coherence & Cohesion.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. My morning ________ includes 30 minutes of jogging and eating a healthy breakfast.
2. Linh loves helping people, so she decided to ________ at the local animal shelter.
3. Every student should learn how to become a responsible global ________.
4. If you want to achieve IELTS 5.5, you must ________ a clear study goal.
5. Many young people in our ________ take part in cleaning public parks on Sundays.
6. It takes at least 21 days to break a bad ________ like staying up late.
7. Cycling to school instead of using motorbikes helps promote a greener ________.
8. We are holding a workshop to help students ________ their English pronunciation.
9. Students are strongly encouraged to participate ________ community service.
10. The United Nations works for ________ development across developing countries.
11. Volunteering provides teenagers with a valuable ________ to gain practical experience.
12. Small daily actions can make a huge ________ to our natural environment.
13. The teacher always gives extra ________ to students who struggle with grammar.
14. UNESCO is an ________ organization that promotes global education and culture.
15. Plastic pollution causes serious damage to the marine ________.
16. You cannot succeed if you only ________ on luck instead of daily hard work.
17. Does this notebook ________ to you, or is it borrowed from the library?
18. Over 200 youth volunteers took ________ in the tree-planting festival yesterday.
19. She has a busy work ________, yet she still manages to read 20 pages every night.
20. Being an active member of your local ________ helps you build strong friendships.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Listen! The children ________ a traditional song in the community center.
2. Nam usually ________ to school by bike, but this week he ________ the public bus.
3. I'm sorry, I cannot hear you clearly because I ________ what you are saying.
4. Be quiet! My father ________ an important email to the international organization at the moment.
5. Peter is very untidy! He ________ his plastic bottles on the floor!
6. I ________ about volunteering for the green community project this summer. What do you think?
7. Organic vegetables from our community garden ________ fresh and delicious.
8. Look at the official timetable! What time ________ the train to Da Nang ________ tomorrow morning?
9. Every citizen ________ a duty to protect the natural environment.
10. Right now, more and more teenagers ________ in sustainable lifestyle campaigns.
Điểm: 0/10

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - Global Youth Movement]
Around the world today, more than 1.2 billion young people are stepping forward to make a positive difference in their local neighborhoods. Through the United Nations Youth Programme, teenagers are proving that age is not a barrier to creating sustainable communities and a healthier lifestyle.

[Paragraph B - Local Action in Da Nang]
Take Linh Nguyen, a 15-year-old student from Da Nang, Vietnam. Every Saturday morning, as part of her weekend routine, Linh leads a group of twenty neighborhood volunteers called the "Green Cleaners." The group gathers at 7:30 AM to participate in collecting plastic waste along the local beach. In just six months, they have gathered over 800 kilograms of recyclable bottles and paper.

[Paragraph C - Habits & Future Goals]
"Many people believe that protecting the environment is only the duty of international organizations," Linh explains. "However, I believe that small daily habits create huge changes." Besides environmental cleanups, the group also provides support and teaches basic English to younger children every Sunday afternoon. This valuable opportunity helps Linh improve her leadership skills, and her ultimate goal is to become an environmental diplomat as a responsible global citizen.
Điểm: 0/6
